geeklist.title: GAMESGALORE’S 2025 BGG AUCTION #27 – GAMES FROM A-G (2000-2023) – ENDS WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 12TH!!
geeklist.description:
For my next two auctions, I’ve gone through my list of games and decided to do them alphabetically. Accordingly, for this auction I’m offering 18 games from A-G (actually a few numbers in there as well)!! All of the games are complete (with one minor exception), and in Excellent shape! They are priced to sell, so if you want some really unique games to add to your collection, this is where to find them!! Check them out and grab the ones you want!! More details of this sale follow:
[u][b]The Auction - Specifics[/b][/u]
[b]1. This is a BGG Flea Market auction…all sales will be run through BGG [u]in bulk[/u] so BGG receives its commission! 2. Auction Ends – Wednesday, November 12th[/b] 3. All buyers welcome…will ship worldwide 4. All bids must be in whole US dollar increments 5. Please add a zip code to all bids as this expedites the billing process at the end of the auction 6. All games will have a minimum bid AND a Buy It Now (BIN) price…no “reserves” 7. The auction will end on November 12th after there is no activity for a period of one hour past 8pm EST that evening 8. If there is activity from 8pm to 9pm EST that evening, the auction for that item will be extended by one hour 9. This will continue until an hour goes by with no activity on the item, at which point the auction will end
[b]Payments & Shipping[/b]
1. You will receive a billing notice from me through Geekmail regarding your auction winnings 2. [u]BGG gets its commission from a single “bulk bill” at the end of the auction[/u]. The winning bidders will receive a billing notice through GeekMail from me…the sales will [u][b]NOT[/b][/u] individually run through the BGG Marketplace. This is a standard and accepted practice from BGG and they will get their full commission at the end of the auction! 3. Payments will be through PayPal at the end of the auction 4. Payment is expected [u][b]within three days of the close of the auction; this is very important…please make payment promptly![/b][/u] 5. Shipping will be through USPS Priority Mail, USPS International Mail or UPS 6. Buyer is responsible for shipping costs 7. Shipping will be from zip code 43021 8. I will combine games to get the best shipping prices 9. You are welcome to pick up your games locally (in the Columbus, OH area) if you want to save the shipping and handling charges. We can make arrangements post-auction.
That’s it! Good luck to everyone and thank you for your interest. Please feel free to contact me through BGG if you have any questions!
Lyle Rhodebeck Gamesgalore
